prompt: User asks for unclassified notes, then moves RSC note to areas/frontend

assertions.name: lists_pending_notes
assertions.text: Agent lists inbox notes with pending_review status including the RSC note title

assertions.name: file_moved
assertions.text: File physically moved from inbox/ to areas/frontend/

assertions.name: status_updated
assertions.text: Frontmatter status changed from pending_review to classified

assertions.name: git_committed
assertions.text: A git commit was created for the classification move
